entries.name: autoSelect
entries.description: Auto select the account if the user is already signed in

entries.name: cancelOnTapOutside
entries.description:
Cancel the flow when the user taps outside the prompt

Note: To use this option, disable `promptOptions.fedCM`

entries.name: uxMode
entries.description:
The mode to use for the Google One Tap flow

popup: Use a popup window
redirect: Redirect the user to the Google One Tap flow

entries.name: additionalOptions
entries.description: Additional configuration options to pass to the Google One Tap API.

entries.name: onPromptNotification
entries.description:
Optional callback that receives the prompt notification if (or when) the prompt is dismissed or skipped.
This lets you render an alternative UI (e.g. a Google Sign-In button) to restart the process.

entries.name: views
entries.description: Auth views that may open the prompt.
